svg.title: One document, split three ways
svg.desc: A hand-drawn whiteboard showing the same ruled document as four tall panels. At 128 tokens the highlighted answer passage is cut in half by a thick red line and Recall@10 is 0.71; at 2048 tokens the answer is a thin highlighted sliver inside one huge block, 0.74; at 512 tokens it sits wholly inside one chunk with amber 64-token overlap bands on every seam, 0.83; and a parent-child panel embeds four 256-token children that point up into a 1024-token parent. Below, an inverted-U curve plots Recall@10 of 0.71, 0.79, 0.83, 0.81 and 0.74 against chunk sizes 128 to 2048 with the peak at 512 ringed in green.
